assessments.reasoning: OSI’s digest-matched record 406 requires the owner to place “Licensed under the Open Software License version 3.0” adjacent to the copyright notice. Its title, type and sections 1–3 document the ordinary software license.

The Index owns its data model and admits licenses with a controlling source, grant and identifiable edition. Those criteria support maintaining ordinary OSL 3.0 as its own reference, while qualification requires a separate selection record.

limitations: Active describes the intended Index reference. Actual selection in a qualified release, a grant for a particular work, reuse rights and installation eligibility each require additional evidence.
